title: ENG25519 awarded USENIX Security 2024 Distinguished Paper Award!
description: Our paper "ENG25519: Faster TLS 1.3 handshake using optimized X25519 and Ed25519" won the prestigious Distinguished Paper Award at the 33rd USENIX Security Symposium (19.1% acceptance rate, top 5% award rate).

title: VAXEN accepted to MICRO 2026
description: Our paper "VAXEN: A Versatile AVX Extension for Zero-Knowledge Proof and Post-Quantum Cryptography" has been accepted to the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026).

title: MamaBearZKP accepted to ACM CCS 2026
description: Our paper "MamaBearZKP: A Holistic Co-design of Prime Fields and Proving Stacks for High-Throughput ZKP on Modern CPUs" has been accepted to ACM CCS 2026.

title: TensorZKP accepted to USENIX Security 2026
description: Our paper "TensorZKP: Repurposing GPU Tensor Cores for High-Performance Zero-Knowledge Proofs" has been accepted to the 35th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 2026).

title: Two papers accepted to IACR TCHES 2026
description: Two papers accepted to IACR Transactions on Cryptographic Hardware and Embedded Systems (TCHES 2026): AVX-512 SIMD BLS signatures (Issue 3) and Vectorized Falcon-Sign on SSE2/AVX2/AVX-512/NEON/RVV (Issue 1).

title: Appointed to Program Committee for USENIX Security '27, CHES '27, and SAC '26
description: Honored to serve on the Program Committees of the 36th USENIX Security Symposium (2027), IACR CHES 2027, and Selected Areas in Cryptography (SAC 2026).
